episodes.title: Our Stuff
episodes.summary: After the bears play a little pickup basketball (they're very bad), they go back to grab their stuff by the side of the court only to find it's been stolen! The Bears race across town trying to track down their stuff and end up cracking a giant case in the process.

episodes.title: Viral Video
episodes.summary: The Bears think they have what it takes to make and star in a viral video, but when Nom-Nom decides that they don't, Grizz breaks into the koala's limo in an effort to change his mind.

episodes.title: Food Truck
episodes.summary: The Bears open up a food truck after being disappointed by the food options available to them. In an effort to drum up business, they start selling their food to animals until the animals go a little crazy.

episodes.title: Chloe
episodes.summary: Chloe spends time with the Bears in an effort to research them for an upcoming presentation. But when the Bears sneak a peek at her very dry report, the Bears decide to jazz it up with exaggerated "facts" about themselves and their lifestyle.

episodes.title: Panda's Date
episodes.summary: When a vendor at the Farmer's Market (LUCY) sticks Panda with an EpiPen reviving him after an allergic reaction, Panda comes to in the arms of his dream girl. Panda tries to woo this woman of his dreams but his brothers and his own insecurities get in the way.

episodes.title: Everyday Bears
episodes.summary: It's a normal day for the Bears. This means that Ice gets in a fight with a Roomba, Panda's life gets turned upside down when a mouse invades his room and Grizz gets stuck in a tree. You know, everyday stuff for a bear.

episodes.title: Burrito
episodes.summary: Grizz likes Burritos. A lot. So much so that after a restaurant makes a Bear-Sized Burrito, Grizz can't bring himself to eat such a majestic work of art. He carries the burrito everywhere making it a new and increasingly smelly part of his life.

episodes.title: Primal
episodes.summary: Have the Bears lost their survival instincts by living in the modern world? Grizz wants to know so he purposefully gets the Bears lost in the deep forest.

episodes.title: Jean Jacket
episodes.summary: The Bears find a bedazzled jean jacket in a dumpster. It's just about the coolest thing they've ever seen and seems to make the wearer of the jacket extremely lucky. But after the Bears fight over who gets control of the jacket, they have to consider that their denim blessing has become a curse.

episodes.title: Nom Nom
episodes.summary: When Nom Nom shows up on the Bears' doorstep, disheveled and deposed from his spot as cutest internet star ever after a recent meltdown, he enlists the Bears to help him regain his title.

episodes.title: Shush Ninjas
episodes.summary: The Bears are fed up with the decay of etiquette at today's theaters. Aren't you? The Bears take it upon themselves to be the police of the theater, sneaking up like ninjas to shush people who ruin the movie for others with their bad manners.

episodes.title: My Clique
episodes.summary: Chloe, a child prodigy, finds it difficult to connect with her much older classmates. The Bears take her under their wing and show her how to make great college friends.

episodes.title: Charlie
episodes.summary: You know that one annoying friend who just can't get the hint? That's Charlie, and he's Bigfoot. The Bears meet him when Charlie signs up on a home-sharing website to spend a weekend with the Bears. Charlie is the worst possible house guest for the Bears and nearly destroys their house.

episodes.title: Brother Up
episodes.summary: After Panda stumbles and accidentally scares a pack of wolves away in the process, the hierarchy of the Bears is disrupted. Suddenly, Panda has become the alpha bear, and he and Grizz have to deal with the consequences of an emotional Panda being the leader of the three Bears.

episodes.title: Occupy Bears
episodes.summary: When the city plans to destroy the Bears' cave in order to make way for a new cell phone tower, Grizz and Panda must find evidence from their past that proves they have rights to their land. And in case that fails, Ice Bear protests and tries to sabotage the construction crew.

episodes.title: Panda's Sneeze
episodes.summary: Panda bears have a very adorable (and violent!) sneeze, and our Panda is no exception. When a Vine video of his very cute sneeze goes viral, Panda becomes a "cute" sensation, which causes Nom Nom to try to fend off of this new challenger to his throne.

episodes.title: The Road
episodes.summary: This episode takes place when the Bears are young cubs! The three bears, on their way through the desert, come upon a giant warehouse. It's like an Amazon fulfillment center. The Bears try to make this box-filled paradise their home.

episodes.title: Emergency
episodes.summary: When Grizz comes home with a live crab, he thinks it can become a pet for the brothers to share. However, after the crab pinches Ice Bear's ear and won't let go, Panda and Grizz have to get their injured brother to the hospital, and fast!

episodes.title: Tote Life
episodes.summary: When a hipster grocery store clerk shames the Bears for asking for plastic grocery bags, the Bears realize that eco-friendly tote bags are their way of gaining acceptance amongst the progressive people of the Bay Area. But in their effort to gain popularity, the Bears let the culture of tote bags take over their lives.

episodes.title: Charlie & the Snake
episodes.summary: Charlie is a solo guy who, like the Bears, would love to find a place for himself in the world. In an effort to do so, Charlie throws a party, but ends up going on an adventure with the unlikeliest of animals, a wild snake.

episodes.title: Video Date
episodes.summary: Panda is an avid e-dater, and when a lovely French woman matches with him and agrees to a video chat date, Panda and his brothers engineer the situation so Panda is able to show the best side of himself on the video chat, even if that side of him is completely exaggerated.

episodes.title: Pet Shop
episodes.summary: Pet Shop tells the tale of where the Baby Bears once lived, and after a run-in with a video crew shooting a Sarah McLachlan-type animal adoption video, almost seized an opportunity to find a home separated from each other.

episodes.title: Chloe and Ice Bear
episodes.summary: On a day out with just Ice Bear, Chloe realizes Ice Bear only runs errands for his brothers. Determined to show him a fun day in the city, Chloe promises to help Ice Bear have a good time, even if it means staying in a museum after it closes.

episodes.title: Cupcake Job
episodes.summary: When the Bears' beloved laptop breaks, they finally have the need to do something they've never done before: get jobs. Working at a trendy cupcake shop, the Bears find that the working world is much tougher than they realized.

episodes.title: Hibernation
episodes.summary: The bears, being an urban bunch, hadn't ever heard of the idea of hibernation until Chloe tells them about it. Grizz, loving the idea of eating a ton and then just sleeping to his heart's content, goes for it with reckless abandon. But Grizz is so excited for hibernating... that he can't fall asleep.

episodes.title: Charlie Ball
episodes.summary: The Bears invite Charlie to be on their team after Panda gets hurt; Charlie ruins the fun of the game.

episodes.title: Yard Sale
episodes.summary: Each of the Bears get offbeat items at a local yard sale. Their new possessions send them on their own separate adventures.

episodes.title: Slumber Party
episodes.summary: A thunderstorm forces Chloe to spend the night at the bear's cave. When Chloe's parents tell the bears to make sure she stays safe, they go a bit overboard.

episodes.title: Bear Cleanse
episodes.summary: A doctor tells the Bears to go on a cleanse to improve their health. But when Grizz realizes he can only eat what grizzly bears eat, he starts to lose his mind.

episodes.title: Nom Nom's Entourage
episodes.summary: Nom Nom recruits the Bears to act as his entourage of friends. But when the Bears realize Nom Nom doesn't understand friendship, they decide to kick their day of bonding into high gear.

episodes.title: Ranger Tabes
episodes.summary: To recover a missing package, the Bears get help from Ranger Tabes, an eccentric forest ranger. But her overblown sense of justice might be too much for the Bears to handle.

episodes.title: Rooms
episodes.summary: When the bears decide to swap bedrooms for the night, they find out hidden secrets about their brothers.

episodes.title: Losing Ice
episodes.summary: Feeling unappreciated by his brothers, Ice Bear leaves to become a chef, while Panda and Grizz try to find a replacement.

episodes.title: Cellie
episodes.summary: Fed up with sharing, Panda forbids his brothers from using his cellphone any longer. But when the brothers get their own super advanced smartphones, Panda starts to succumb to crippling jealousy.

episodes.title: Fashion Bears
episodes.summary: In order to abide by the clothing policy of their favorite Boba shop, the Bears get some new outfits. But with new looks come new lives including office work, fashion modeling and even falling in love!

episodes.title: The Island
episodes.summary: The baby bears get stranded on a deserted island, where they meet two castaways. When they try to get off the island, they find out that someone is sabotaging their ques

episodes.title: Bear Flu
episodes.summary: After they swim in a dirty lake, the bears become convinced they have the bear flu, and Chloe decides to act as nurse.

episodes.title: Chicken and Waffles
episodes.summary: Panda needs to meet his brothers at the most exclusive restaurant in town. But when he loses his contacts lenses and can't see, Panda needs Charlie's help to get him into the city.

episodes.title: The Audition
episodes.summary: The Audition: The Bears audition to be the next mascot for their favorite cereal. They get so caught up in the process that their competitiveness gets the best of them.

episodes.title: Captain Craboo, Part 1
episodes.summary: The bears are reunited with their pet crab, Captain Craboo. But after an unfortunate run-in with Nom Nom, the bears may lose their pet forever.

episodes.title: Captain Craboo, Part 2
episodes.summary: After being deemed guilty, the Bears must now live life on the lam, but when the cops track their location, they must outrun the police to arrive at the ocean and let Craboo go instead of letting them take Craboo away forever.

episodes.title: Baby Bears on a Plane
episodes.summary: The Baby Bears have an adventure in the sky while aboard a plane to Sweden. But when the baby Bears are forced to sit in different sections of the plan, things get a bit haywire for everyone on board.

episodes.title: Yuri and the Bear
episodes.summary: While living alone in the arctic, baby Ice Bear meets a mysterious man who helps him survive the frigid environment.

episodes.title: Icy Nights
episodes.summary: Ice Bear rides his custom vacuum into the city. But when a gang of techies steal the vacuum, Ice Bear goes on a rescue mission that takes him through the underground world of the city.

episodes.title: Everyone's Tube
episodes.summary: A anonymous person clicks on a variety of musical videos uploaded by the bears in a compilation style, and we catch a glimpse of what the bears have uploaded.

episodes.title: Creature Mysteries
episodes.summary: After learning Ranger Tabes is investigating Charlie, the bears split up to ensure their friend's safety.

episodes.title: The Library
episodes.summary: The Bears find Chloe in the library exhausted from studying for an exam all day. The Bears stay to help Chloe study but make things worse in the process.

episodes.title: Grizz Helps
episodes.summary: When his brothers don't need his help for the day, Grizz leaves the cave to assist anyone he can throughout the city.

episodes.title: Christmas Parties
episodes.summary: The Bears have been invited to all their friends' Christmas parties. In an effort to have time to crash Nom Nom's huge star-studded bash, the Bears first try to make quick stops at all their friends' parties throughout the night.

episodes.title: Grizzly the Movie
episodes.summary: Grizz gets cast in a movie about a grizzly bear, but soon realizes the movie's depiction of grizzly bears goes against what he had in mind.

episodes.title: Subway
episodes.summary: The Bears become stranded on a subway platform after missing their train, but while waiting, the Bears must recover some lost items.

episodes.title: Anger Management
episodes.summary: In order to appear on a successful kids show, Nom Nom must successfully complete anger management, with Grizz as his partner.

episodes.title: Panda's Friend
episodes.summary: Panda uses an app to find a friend with whom he has more in common, but things take a turn for the worse when the new friend gets too possessive.
The Baby Bears' dreams come true when they discover a $100 bill; when they can't bear to spend it, they have difficulty letting go.

episodes.title: Neighbors
episodes.summary: New neighbors set up camp next to the cave. The bears love it at first, but when Grizz overhears them talking about their questionable previous bear encounters, he begins an investigation.

episodes.title: Professor Lampwick
episodes.summary: The Bears try to help when Chloe is unable to speak to her professor about a poor grade, but their efforts only make the situation worse.

episodes.title: Ralph
episodes.summary: Charlie meets a creature just like him named Ralph, but the Bears think Ralph is bad news.

episodes.title: Planet Bears
episodes.summary: A nature documentary follows the Bears through their normal routine, which includes a trip to the grocery store.

episodes.title: Coffee Cave
episodes.summary: After finding out Ice Bear is a master barista, the Bears turn their cave into a popular coffee shop. But it all goes awry when Ice Bear gets too into coffee and goes berserk.

episodes.title: Charlie's Big Foot
episodes.summary: When Charlie suffers an injury to his foot, the bears must sneak him into a hospital for medical assistance.

episodes.title: The Demon
episodes.summary: When Chloe and Ice Bear lose her prized hoodie to the dog next door, they set out on a mission to retrieve it.

episodes.title: Panda's Art
episodes.summary: Panda paints a picture of Charlie that gains notoriety, and when an art dealer makes an offer, Panda must get the painting from Charlie.

episodes.title: Poppy Rangers
episodes.summary: Ranger Tabes guides a troop of young girls into a cave expedition, and uses Grizz as their cave expert.

episodes.title: Lucy's Brother
episodes.summary: Panda offers to babysit Lucy's brother in order to impress her, but he is too much for Panda to handle.

episodes.title: The Fair
episodes.summary: The Baby Bears make a deal with a carnival worker to be prizes for a game of ball toss.

episodes.title: Private Lake
episodes.summary: When the local lake is overcrowded with tourists, the Bears have fun at Charlie's private lake. However, trouble rises when the Bears mistakenly make its presence known on social media.

episodes.title: Lunch with Tabes
episodes.summary: The Bears have lunch with Ranger Tabes, but when Tabes' lunch gets stolen, Tabes goes into full on detective mode to find the culprit.

episodes.title: Road Trip
episodes.summary: Chloe and the Bears take a road trip to see a meteor shower. Ice Bear, the only one licensed to drive, is put in charge, which becomes harder than he thought, especially when they pick up a hitchhiker.

episodes.title: Summer Love
episodes.summary: Panda goes on a mission to return a lost phone to the girl of his dreams and encounters various obstacles along the way including the Mad Scientist from "Grizz Helps".

episodes.title: The Kitty
episodes.summary: After a mishap in the forest, the Bears lose their own home to dangerous animals.

episodes.title: Crowbar Jones
episodes.summary: Grizz screens an epic amateur movie he just made for a focus group, but when he notices people are leaving he must figure out ways to keep the audience engaged.

episodes.title: Kyle
episodes.summary: Nom Nom is reunited with his long-lost brother, Kyle.

episodes.title: Citizen Tabes
episodes.summary: After Ranger Tabes accidentally wounds an animal and quits her job, the Bears do what they can to get her to return to work.

episodes.title: Dance Lessons
episodes.summary: Panda volunteers to be Lucy's partner for a dance contest, but doesn't have the heart to tell her that she's a terrible dancer.

episodes.title: Icy Nights II
episodes.summary: Ice Bear goes on a late-night adventure to rescue his friend, Yana, from some familiar foes.

episodes.title: Dog Hotel
episodes.summary: With no place to stay while their cave gets fumigated, the Bears book a night at a hotel for dogs.

episodes.title: Bear Lift
episodes.summary: To raise money to save Darrell's store, the Bears use the stack as a taxi through a ride share app.

episodes.title: The Nom Nom Show
episodes.summary: Things go awry while Nom Nom shoots his TV show; the bears offer to help and appear on the show.

episodes.title: Ice Cave
episodes.summary: Ralph takes over the cave, turning it into a snowy fortress where he reigns as king over the bears and Charlie.

episodes.title: Spa Day
episodes.summary: The Bears have a relaxing day at the spa. Grizz tries to get everything the spa has to offer. Panda gets trapped in the steam room with an old man. And Ice Bear plays ping pong.

episodes.title: Charlie's Halloween Thing
episodes.summary: Charlie hosts an evening of scary stories starring the Bears.

episodes.title: Bunnies
episodes.summary: The Baby Bears meet a group of helpless bunnies; when they find out the bunnies live in fear of vicious crows, the Bears decide to become heroes and help out.

episodes.title: Pigeons
episodes.summary: Grizz becomes friendly with a flock of pigeons.

episodes.title: Tubin'
episodes.summary: In search of some adventure, the Bears ride a tube down a dangerous river.

episodes.title: Panda 2
episodes.summary: Baby Panda happily lives in a closed off environment for study. But when he's given a new friend, Panda 2, his worldview is shaken, which sets him off on a great adventure.

episodes.title: Lazer Royale
episodes.summary: The Baby Bears sign up for a game of laser tag, hoping to win some ice cream. But, the round of laser tag turns out to be less of a game and more like a war zone.

episodes.title: Ranger Games
episodes.summary: Grizz helps Ranger Tabes and the Poppy Rangers play a game of kickball against their rivals.

episodes.title: The Perfect Tree
episodes.summary: Chloe and Ice Bear drive up north to find the perfect Christmas tree while Grizz and Panda are decorating Chloe's house.

episodes.title: Bearz II Men
episodes.summary: The Baby Bears help a teenager accomplish his dream of being a famous singer.

episodes.title: Bro Brawl
episodes.summary: The Bears participate in a brother-themed game show against Panda's ex-BFF, Tom, and his roommates.

episodes.title: Hurricane Hal
episodes.summary: A storm rolls in while the Bears are separated. Grizz looks after the Poppy Rangers. Panda is stuck with Charlie in his car. And Chloe and Ice Bear are in the city seeking a ride home.

episodes.title: Vacation
episodes.summary: Nom Nom is ordered by his doctor to take a vacation. But he's paired with an unlikely travel buddy: Grizz.

episodes.title: Beehive
episodes.summary: The Bears allow bees to live in the cave to make honey. But soon the Bears, entranced by the honey, become the bees' mindless servants.

episodes.title: The Park
episodes.summary: The Bears spend a day at the park. Grizz works out. Panda attempts to sell his artwork. Ice Bear trains some kids.

episodes.title: I Am Ice Bear
episodes.summary: After Ice Bear hits his head, Grizz and Panda notice him acting like a different person.

episodes.title: Baby Bears Can't Jump
episodes.summary: In order to win a pizza, the Baby Bears play basketball against a ragtag gang of kids.

episodes.title: Go Fish
episodes.summary: While on a fishing trip, the Bears get attacked by a giant legendary fish.

episodes.title: Teacher's Pet
episodes.summary: The Baby Bears escape their hectic lives by attending school.

episodes.title: Googs
episodes.summary: The Bears win a tour of the infamous Googs corporate headquarters.

episodes.title: Paperboyz
episodes.summary: The Baby Bears get jobs as paper boys.

episodes.title: Bear Squad
episodes.summary: Tabes deputizes the Bears so they can go to the city and catch a thief.

episodes.title: Lil' Squid
episodes.summary: The Baby Bears build a submarine and explore the depths of an aquarium so they can bring a lost squid to its family.

episodes.title: I, Butler
episodes.summary: The Bears use a robot bear to help around the house. But things get tricky when they lose control of the robot.

episodes.title: Family Troubles
episodes.summary: Baby Grizz lives on the set of a sitcom in which he stars. But when a cooler kid joins the cast, Grizz feels threatened.

episodes.title: Best Bears
episodes.summary: The Bears must complete their Best-Man duties on the day of Darrell's wedding.

episodes.title: Crowbar Jones: Origins
episodes.summary: Grizz screens an epic amateur movie he just made for a focus group. But when he notices people are leaving he must figure out ways to keep the audience engaged.

episodes.title: Hot Sauce
episodes.summary: A quest for their favorite hot sauce causes the Bears to get involved with a sting operation.

episodes.title: Mom App
episodes.summary: Hoping to finally get the mom-experience, the Bears use an app that'll bring a mom right to their door.

episodes.title: The Limo
episodes.summary: To help distract Panda from his girl problems, Grizz and Ice Bear treat him to a ride in a limo.

episodes.title: More Everyone's Tube
episodes.summary: Through another video browsing session online, we get more videos uploaded by the Bears and their friends.

episodes.title: Money Man
episodes.summary: The Bears help Chloe present her project for a college science contest. But Chloe's rival makes things difficult.

episodes.title: Rescue Ranger
episodes.summary: Tabes helps the Bears rescue Charlie after he gets captured by a villainous game hunter.

episodes.title: El Oso
episodes.summary: In a flashback to long ago, Charlie has an adventure in the Mexican desert.

episodes.title: Charlie's Halloween Thing 2
episodes.summary: Charlie tells some scary stories featuring the Bears and their friends.

episodes.title: Escandalosos
episodes.summary: The Baby Bears enter a Mexican wrestling tournament.

episodes.title: Pizza Band
episodes.summary: The Bears get pizza at Papa Bear's Pizza Cave and wind up replacing the place's animatronic band. They're such a hit that they go on tour!.

episodes.title: Adopted
episodes.summary: The Baby Bears get adopted by an eccentric millionaire and get to live in his mansion.

episodes.title: Wingmen
episodes.summary: In order to get some sleep, the Bears help an annoying bird find a new mate.

episodes.title: Braces
episodes.summary: When the Bears go to the dentist, Panda gets braces. But, Panda finds out his braces grant him super abilities and the power goes to his head.

episodes.title: Christmas Movies
episodes.summary: On Christmas Eve, the Baby Bears defend a video store from getting robbed.

episodes.title: Imaginary Friend
episodes.summary: The Baby Bears invent an imaginary friend, but the trouble he causes is all too real.

episodes.title: The Mall
episodes.summary: The Bears go the mall and encounter their human counterparts.

episodes.title: Tunnels
episodes.summary: The Bears discover a network of tunnels underneath the cave. Are they prepared to discover where they lead to and who dug them?.

episodes.title: Ramen
episodes.summary: The Baby Bears help a struggling ramen chef perfect her ramen and save her shop.

episodes.title: The Gym
episodes.summary: The Bears go to the gym and get quite the work out.

episodes.title: Bubble
episodes.summary: Panda becomes a germophobe and decides to live the rest of his life in a bubble.

episodes.title: Baby Orphan Ninja Bears
episodes.summary: The Baby Bears venture into the sewers and meet a ninja-like martial arts master.

episodes.title: Fire!
episodes.summary: Grizz's quick thinking prevents a potential wild fire, but the praise he receives from doing so quickly goes to his head.

episodes.title: Ranger Norm
episodes.summary: When Tabes leaves for a conference, the Bears have to deal with her substitute, Ranger Norm.

episodes.title: Shmorby
episodes.summary: The Bears get a Shmorby home assistant device and become lazy couch potatoes.

episodes.title: Snake Babies
episodes.summary: Charlie adopts baby snakes despite the Bears thinking he's not ready for parenthood.

episodes.title: Sandcastle
episodes.summary: The Baby Bears build a giant sandcastle. But when some kids declare war on the Bears, they must fight to defend their new home.

episodes.title: Bros in the City
episodes.summary: The Bears star in a reality TV show along with Griff, Tom, and Isaac.

episodes.title: Cousin Jon
episodes.summary: When the Bears attend Chloe's family reunion, they fall victim to the mischievous pranks of Chloe's cousin, Jon.

episodes.title: Lord of the Poppies
episodes.summary: Grizz and the Poppy Rangers go camping on an island, but they soon find themselves deserted.

episodes.title: The Mummy's Curse
episodes.summary: The Baby Bears must return a mummy to its tomb or else they'll be cursed forever.

episodes.title: Band of Outsiders
episodes.summary: A gang of streetwise kids takes Baby Ice Bear under their wing.

episodes.title: Tabes & Charlie
episodes.summary: Tabes and Charlie team up to find Tabes' missing dog, Kirk.

episodes.title: Panda's Birthday
episodes.summary: For Panda's Birthday, the Bears try to help Panda meet his favorite K-Pop band, Monsta X.
